quote: First time in lovely place. Cosy by name……
author: Mark Webb

quote: Such a lovely new place! It's warm, comforting and has such a welcoming atmosphere — the kind of place you can pop into for a coffee and food, or stay a little longer and enjoy a drink or cocktail.
author: Georgia Fitness

quote: The coffee was delicious, a hazelnut and chocolate medium roast. Not Costa… this is actually coffee. The staff are warm and welcoming and prob the nicest service I've had in years. If I wasn't travelling through it would be my staple coffee stop!
author: Carlos

quote: Good coffee, lovely staff, cafe nicely presented, will definitely use again. Recommend, pop in, order a coffee, grab a book and chill awhile.
author: Brian Ingram
